findings.title: Canonical command for an uncovered `independent` meta-class slot is unpinned in the engine spec; orbit-review's new proposal phrasings unilaterally pick `--fresh`
findings.recommendation: orbit-engine-gates' 'Single-voiced canonical-next computation' requires the ENGINE to compute the one canonical next command and skills to render it verbatim, but neither that requirement nor 'spec-driven v1 gates and cadence' pins which command an uncovered `independent` slot (fresh OR external) resolves to. The new orbit-review proposal scenarios (P1/P3, specs/orbit-review/spec.md:12,22) hardcode `/orbit:review --as proposal --fresh <change>` with no engine-side anchor — if an implementer wires the engine to emit `/orbit:review-external` for the independent slot, the two specs contradict. Pin it in orbit-engine-gates: an uncovered `independent` slot's canonical command is the fresh-context review (the proposal-phase default), with external named as a user substitute that also satisfies the slot; orbit-review then renders the engine-computed command.

findings.title: Current in-context pass's counting toward the trailing `in-context` slot is unspecified — the P4↔P5 boundary is ambiguous and the gate can't converge cleanly through an in-context confirm run
findings.recommendation: The trailing cadence slot is `in-context`, which is exactly what a `/orbit:review --as proposal` (in-context) run produces. But gate state is 'a pure function of existing on-disk artifacts' (orbit-engine-gates) and the final assessment is computed at Step 9, BEFORE this run's emit is written at Step 10 — so when a user runs the in-context confirm right after a clean independent pass, the engine reads a trail lacking this pass and emits P4 ('Next: /orbit:review --as proposal <change>' — telling the user to run what they just ran) instead of P5 (gate passed → apply). Specify that orbit-review's proposal final-assessment computes gate state as-of THIS pass's completion (the current in-context pass satisfies the trailing in-context slot), so a clean independent pass followed by this in-context review yields P5. Otherwise the gate only converges on a confusing second in-context run.
